symptom: Repair v37 passed partial candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, playable content coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, and isolated validate-candidates. The 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix still failed because BossHunterBot stayed over target at 100.0% against a 45%-75% target, while RouteBot remained too high at 66.7% against a 10%-35% target. IdleBot, RandomBot, CowardBot, GreedyXpBot, KiteBot, TankBot, and ZoneControlBot all stayed inside target.
root_cause: The v37 repair tested Candy Crystal Lance at 30 damage / 1078ms while keeping projectile speed and range at v31 values. BossHunterBot still won all three seeds, while v34 at 30 damage / 1080ms won zero seeds. This narrows the observed cooldown threshold to the 1078ms-1080ms gap and shows that this weapon timing currently behaves like a brittle switch in the 300s boss window. RouteBot remains a separate fixed-route pressure issue because its two winning seeds are unchanged by these boss weapon tweaks.
fix: Do not promote v37 into accepted_content, Runtime content, simulated_candidates, or playtest_candidates. For v38, keep v31 as the base, keep waves unchanged, and test Candy Crystal Lance at 30 damage / 1079ms with projectile speed 620 and range 550. If 1079ms still flips all three BossHunter seeds to either 0/3 or 3/3, stop relying only on cooldown and move to a less binary repair lever such as boss-window pressure, boss health timing, or BossHunter upgrade weighting evidence.
validation: v37 validation reports are in harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v37_* and the failing smoke matrix is harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v37_matrix_300s_3seed_71000_001/summary.md. The next candidate should first rerun the same 71000-71002 smoke matrix. Passing requires Coward and Route between 10%-35%, Greedy / Tank / ZoneControl between 25%-55%, Kite / BossHunter between 45%-75%, and Idle / Random inside their floor bands before any 10-seed expansion or Replay regression.
